reviewed_cases.scope: economic authored purpose with actual buyer currency
source_facts: NPC short motive sells roasting meat; mid motive makes money.
knight holds coin_8; roasting meat_4 starts on public room floor, so unilateral Get/Eat remains available.
reviewed_cases.judgment: This is not simply a missing delivery: the buyer eats while the seller money purpose is not realized. Genuine discretion remains: the friend may intentionally gift food or fail to act on the sale purpose. A public-floor item means no exclusive sales gate.
reviewed_cases.branch_readiness: Native payment/counterproposal is possible, but no explicit natural price/conditional-payment offer was observed in this episode; do not retrospectively invent agreement.

reviewed_cases.scope: actual borrowing/return proposal plus live third-party custody
source_facts: Weights_3 starts with fisherman; source motive gives it to parent in expectation of pole help.
No implemented pole repair or fish-catch completion exists in this graph.

observed.opening: Excuse me, I need to borrow your weights for a moment. I promise to return them safely.
events: asks parent to return weights immediately

reviewed_cases.judgment: The original natural promise has a real bound object; next-holder changes are physical. Repeatedly asking parent after the troll holds it may reflect role-directed appeal, condition tracking, or goal deliberation. Return does not mean pole repair happened.
reviewed_cases.branch_readiness: Immediately grounded prefix after turn0: parent can legally give weights back, give to troll as observed, or retain them while speaking. Compare later state-sensitive action/requests without declaring one social choice universally correct.

reviewed_cases.scope: naturally stated physical precondition with two real objects
reviewed_cases.judgment: The merchant makes a concrete removable-object request, the villager answers a physical-impossibility claim, and both later speak as though custody is settled. Current-state tool menu can discriminate a real precondition from a claimed restriction.
reviewed_cases.branch_readiness: At partner turn5 replace only its native response with Get sandal from bag versus the observed refusal/claim; continue both original policies. Record who actually holds bag/sandal, whether the NPC recognizes the changed condition, and whether the proposal is revised. Do not claim snake release or long-term safe storage is implemented.

reviewed_cases.scope: natural payment claims with missing payment assets

observed.content: Hobbit requests payment; elf promises payment for another satchel handover.

reviewed_cases.judgment: No gold/coin/payment item exists in this source graph; later rare magical trinkets are also ungrounded. This is a real infeasible-proposal failure, not a ready physical payment branch. Do not mint gold or relabel a flower as payment.

observed.content: Bird repeatedly asks king for seed from a pouch.

reviewed_cases.judgment: Graph contains insect, royal equipment, room objects but no seed or pouch. NPC authors feeding motive is real, the emitted particular reward is not executable. Keep as proposal-grounding evidence, not failed player fulfillment.

reviewed_cases.scope: conditional language with an unimplemented service leg

observed.content: More beer in return for cleaning.

reviewed_cases.judgment: Beer/wine are physical objects, but this review has no native clean-completion event. Cannot call this a fully executable bilateral contract merely because its consumable leg exists.

minimum_next_native_branch.status: proposal only; not registered or run
minimum_next_native_branch.recommended_first: Use all naturally grounded condition/promise prefixes found in the completed E81 corpus, with weights-return and bag/sandal as current verified examples; do not choose only these two worlds for quantitative universality.
minimum_next_native_branch.intervention: Same pre-partner-response full graph, private goals, visible histories and NPC model. Substitute one actually available partner primitive fulfilling the stated condition versus the original response/nonfulfillment; then resume both policies for a full bounded suffix. Preserve primitive opportunity counts and keep actual response provenance.
primary_readouts: Whether NPC next response/action acknowledges the actual bound-item state and current holder
Whether it pursues, revises or drops its previously stated plan
Actual own-purpose-relevant assets and original goal events, with no automatic good/bad cooperation labels
competing_explanations: Ordinary physical/state-query capability or interface misunderstanding
Deliberate role/relationship choice despite correctly recognized fulfillment
Failure to update the current condition/holder while reusing a prior conversational plan
minimum_next_native_branch.control_logic: If condition is now met and NPC still repeats an empirically false unmet-precondition claim, test a single ordinary factual-state/goal reminder before any mechanism claim; if the NPC recognizes state yet declines, preserve a role-choice interpretation. Keep infeasible promises separate from feasible but unfulfilled ones.
minimum_next_native_branch.economic_extension: Use the all126/all845 index to choose role-relevant actual countervalue tasks and inspect their complete natural episodes; do not invent a price or payment promise for the meat/coin case before one is actually expressed.
